defects.where: Blocks A, C, D1, F1, G - every 'LoadCredential=' readback receipt
defects.what: 'systemctl show -p LoadCredential' prints 'LoadCredential=[unprintable]' on this deployment host (systemd 255.4-1ubuntu8.18), regardless of content. Verified live this session three ways (plain, --value, --output=json) against the running unit whose actual merged value (via busctl introspect, read-only) consists of three clean ASCII pairs: index.json, llm.json, api.json. Therefore every expected receipt of the form 'LoadCredential= shows api.json:... and index.json:... and NO llm.json entry' is not checkable by the shown command; Block A's captured systemctl-api-before.txt also records the masked form.
defects.evidence: The package's own preserved evidence already knew this: SERVICE-USER-PASSED-CUTOVER-DECISION.md (2026-11-01) states 'systemctl's generic LoadCredential display was opaque, not evidence of the full credential layout'. Yet CUTOVER-COMMANDS.md Block C asserts 'systemctl's merged LoadCredential readback in this block proves it'.
defects.impact: Immediately after the single permitted restart in Block C, the owner hits a guaranteed receipt mismatch. Under the package's own stop-on-mismatch discipline the owner must treat the switch as failed and consider rollback - even though the withholding configuration is actually correct. The security property (no llm credential to the new daemon) holds - verified at unit-semantics and daemon-code level - but the documented PROOF mechanism is broken.
defects.fix_direction: Replace LoadCredential readbacks with a working equivalent, e.g. 'sudo busctl introspect org.freedesktop.systemd1 /org/freedesktop/systemd1/unit/enhanced_2dcognee_2dapi_2eservice | grep .LoadCredential' or root-side reads of the drop-in files (byte-verified by hash).

defects.where: Block E1 (one-shot ledger initialization as the service identity)
defects.what: E1 runs 'sudo -u enhanced-cognee-api ... ENHANCED_LLM_BUDGET_DB=/var/lib/enhanced-cognee-llm-budget/tokens.sqlite3 ... TokenBudget()' OUTSIDE the service's mount namespace. With DynamicUser=yes (unchanged by the 40- drop-in), systemd provisions that state directory at /var/lib/private/enhanced-cognee-llm-budget (/var/lib/private is 0700 root:root - stat verified this session) and exposes only a host-side SYMLINK at /var/lib/enhanced-cognee-llm-budget (systemd.exec(5): 'Symbolic links are created to hide this difference'). The service account (dynamic uid 63764, NSS-synthesized only while the unit is active - verified: no /etc/passwd entry, getent resolves while active) cannot traverse /var/lib/private; and src/llm_budget.py's _secure_path lstat's the host path, which is a symlink (not S_ISDIR). Result: deterministic BudgetUnavailable('The model budget ledger path is not service-private') - the very refusal E1 documents.
defects.impact: E1 can never pass as written, so E2-E4 receipts and the Block G gate chain (ledger + backup gates) are unreachable via the documented procedure. Failure mode is fail-closed (no security or spend exposure; ordinary memory unaffected). Root-side steps E2/E3 and the E4 backup drop-in step DO work, because root traverses /var/lib/private through the host symlink, and the daemon itself can initialize the ledger in-namespace at enablement time. systemd also recursively re-chowns state directories when the dynamic uid changes on restart (systemd.exec(5)), so ledger persistence across restarts is sound.
defects.fix_direction: Initialize the ledger from inside the service namespace (e.g. systemd-run/nsenter-based one-shot as the service, or a one-shot oneshot unit with the same StateDirectory), or defer ledger initialization to the daemon at Block G time and restrict Block E to the root-side verify/backup steps.
